guitar.notes: Don Felder's Gibson EDS-1275 double-neck (for 'Hotel California') is iconic; the band also used Telecasters and Les Pauls broadly. Medium confidence reflects the multiple players/instruments.

tone.target: warm clean edge with slight compression and roomy 70s sheen
tone.profile: warm clean edge with slight compression and roomy 70s sheen
tone.summary: A warm, compressed signal chain using a mild boost and US Deluxe amp model, paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cabinet for a smooth, room-drenched 70s sound.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
